title: Bulb normal parameters
description: Essential: Correctly identifies bulb's normal voltage (2V) and calculates normal current (0.2A) from given power rating.

title: Internal resistance calculation
description: Essential: Applies closed-circuit equation E = U_L + I_L(r+R) to solve for internal resistance r, obtaining 1Ω.

title: Motor voltage determination
description: Essential: Uses circuit equation for switch position 2, E = U_L + U_M + I_Lr, to find motor voltage of 0.8V.

title: Efficiency calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes efficiency as useful output power divided by total power, yielding approximately 93.3%.

title: Circuit analysis consistency
description: Important: Maintains consistent current value (0.2A) throughout both circuit configurations, recognizing bulb operates normally in both.

title: Sign error in voltage sums
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adds or subtracts voltage drops in circuit equations, especially forgetting internal resistance drop.

title: Current assumption error
description: Pitfall: Assumes different current through bulb when motor is connected, despite problem stating bulb operates normally.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows unit analysis for resistance, voltage, and efficiency calculations to verify dimensional consistency.
